reason: The audit's strict_equal() checks object key order when comparing raw source-derived objects to comparator RESULT objects. Comparator RESULT is serialized with sort_keys=True, so preimages constructed in settlement/receipts/employment/takes order become alphabetical in RESULT; strict_equal() is deterministically false. The same mismatch affects result.firstObserved and stored terminal row objects. Preserve strict order for comparing the two raw source rows, but use a separate type- and signed-zero-aware dict-content comparison for values that passed through sorted RESULT serialization. Add a synthetic canonicalized-result positive check and pin the observed RESULT digest before execution.
